verdict.rationale: ZCode ships as its own desktop app, browser UI and terminal agent ([zcode-gh-1], [zcode-gh-2]). Community commenters describe it as a standalone Cursor/Conductor-style GUI rather than something embedded in an existing editor. Nothing in the pack mentions a VS Code, JetBrains or other IDE extension that lets a developer chat with the assistant inside their own IDE, so this applicable capability is unevidenced.
